workflow: Multiple threads access a shared value whose derived representation is initialized lazily.
One thread computes and publishes the missing representation while another thread concurrently checks or reads the same cached field through a non-synchronized access.
The unsynchronized read and write form a data race on the shared cache metadata.
Thread-safety instrumentation reports the race, causing the operation or test to fail instead of safely reusing the representation.
summary: Concurrent lazy-cache read races with representation publication
decision_reason: The failure mechanism materially matches the existing cluster: concurrent access to a lazily initialized cached representation without consistent synchronization. The differing symptom is a consistency-check read racing with publication rather than two writers independently publishing the cache.
